Standard: For systems that allow for one or a portion of the crewmembers to use the escape system independently, the ability for remaining crewmembers to subsequently use the escape system is not precluded. Inter-seat systems operate IAW the selected modes. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine the air vehicle configuration and verify that the systems allow remaining crewmembers to use the escape system to leave the air vehicle. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Inter-seat sequencing system breadboard testing shows that system meets the defined modes, logic timing, and signal energy requirements.
  (2) Lab test: For functions controlled by software, software testing shows that the system meets its defined logic and timing.
